card.name: Inside capitalized warning-heading words
card.fires_on: Short letter chunks inside long capitalized words in boxed warning headings, such as SU-IC-IDALITY, ADOLE-SC-ENTS and PEDI-AT-RICS. Also seen in odd split foreign or code-like words.

modes.label: Boxed warning headings
modes.description: Partway through an all-caps word in a WARNING title, mostly suicidality or pediatric terms.

modes.label: Split rare words
modes.description: Partway through an unusual word or code string in general web text.
